title: Follow-up: integrate registry capability relation with bootstrap ledger
description: After the bootstrap capability-ledger work lands, replace the local serialized capability identity and exact hook-to-primitive roster in findingRegistry.ts with the shared ledger relation, or mechanically diff both relations in CI. Preserve engine:F1..engine:F10 identities, the F2 legendary-action primitive, qualified hook selectors, and family ownership. This follow-up is intentionally separate from the current registry correction because the shared ledger is on another PR.
acceptance_criteria: The registry and bootstrap ledger share one exact hook-to-primitive relation; unknown, near-match, wrong-family, and wrong-primitive hooks fail closed; all current capability identities remain stable.
